name: Claude-Code-Game-Studios
tagline_zh: 把 Claude Code 变成你的游戏工作室：49 个 AI 角色各司其职，72 项技能自动流转，从策划到发行。
tagline_en: Turn Claude Code into a game studio: 49 AI roles, 72 workflow skills, one human director—ship games solo.
desc_en: Turn Claude Code into a full game dev studio — 49 AI agents, 72 workflow skills, and a complete coordination system
why_zh: 不是单个 Skill，而是一套完整协作系统：角色分工、任务流转、质量把关，让 AI 像团队一样配合。
why_en: Not a single skill but a full coordination system: roles, handoffs, and QA loops make AI work as a team, not isolated tools.
